newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran inflation 23.2 pct in year to March 97 -paper.
newsitem.headline: Iran inflation 23.2 pct in year to March 97 -paper.

text.p: Iran's annual consumer inflation slowed to 23.2 percent in the Iranian year to March 1997 from 49.4 percent in the previous year, a Tehran newspaper reported on Thursday.

"The overall inflation rate in 1375 (the Iranian year to March 20, 1997) showed a considerable decrease, having been limited to 23.2 percent," the daily Hamshahri said, quoting figures released by the Central Bank.
The Iran daily newspaper on Wednesday had quoted Central Bank Governor Mohsen Nourbakhsh as saying inflation for the year to March 1997 had dropped to 17.4 percent.

Hamshahri made clear that inflation in the final month of the last Iranian year was running at an annual rate of 17.4 percent, but annual inflation for the whole year to March 1997 was 23.2 percent. Inflation in the previous year was 49.4 percent, it added.

Steep price rises are a common complaint and the government has come under attack in the press and parliament for not doing enough to fight inflation, which Iranian officials have said is a top priority.
